All six files are migrated. Here is the complete report.

---

## Migration report

### Files modified

All six route files have been migrated. The external factory function signatures are unchanged — existing callers in `app.ts` require no modifications.

---

### `server/src/routes/environments.ts`

Every handler extracted as `const name: Handler` and wired via `expressHandler`:

| Handler | Line | Route |
|---|---|---|
| `listEnvironments` | 191 | `GET /companies/:companyId/environments` |
| `getEnvironmentCapabilitiesHandler` | 206 | `GET /companies/:companyId/environments/capabilities` |
| `createEnvironment` | 237 | `POST /companies/:companyId/environments` |
| `getEnvironment` | 277 | `GET /environments/:id` |
| `listEnvironmentLeases` | 292 | `GET /environments/:id/leases` |
| `getEnvironmentLease` | 310 | `GET /environment-leases/:leaseId` |
| `updateEnvironment` | 325 | `PATCH /environments/:id` |
| `deleteEnvironment` | 385 | `DELETE /environments/:id` |
| `probeEnvironmentHandler` | 425 | `POST /environments/:id/probe` |
| `probeEnvironmentConfig` | 455 | `POST /companies/:companyId/environments/probe-config` |

Key decisions: `assertCanMutateEnvironments` and `actorCanReadEnvironmentConfigurations` were rewritten as ctx-based helpers. The original helpers read `req.actor.source` and `req.actor.isInstanceAdmin` which are not in `ActorContext`; the rewritten versions delegate permission checks to `accessService.canUser()` to stay transport-agnostic.

---

### `server/src/routes/execution-workspaces.ts`

| Handler | Line | Route |
|---|---|---|
| `listExecutionWorkspaces` | 76 | `GET /companies/:companyId/execution-workspaces` |
| `getExecutionWorkspace` | 93 | `GET /execution-workspaces/:id` |
| `getExecutionWorkspaceCloseReadiness` | 104 | `GET /execution-workspaces/:id/close-readiness` |
| `listWorkspaceOperations` | 119 | `GET /execution-workspaces/:id/workspace-operations` |
| `handleRuntimeCommand` | 131 | `POST /execution-workspaces/:id/runtime-services/:action` and `POST /execution-workspaces/:id/runtime-commands/:action` |
| `updateExecutionWorkspace` | 469 | `PATCH /execution-workspaces/:id` |

Key decisions: `assertCanManageExecutionWorkspaceRuntimeServices` requires the full Express `Request` (reads `req.actor.source`, `isInstanceAdmin`, etc.). It is called in an inline Express middleware that runs before `expressHandler`, with a single `svc.getById` lookup shared between the pre-check and the handler. The `assertNoAgentHostWorkspaceCommandMutation` call was inlined in the PATCH handler using `ctx.actor.type`.

| Handler | Line | Route |

| `listAdapters` | 257 | `GET /adapters` |

The `ui-parser.js` endpoint maps `res.type("application/javascript").send(source)` to `new Response(source, { headers: { "Content-Type": "application/javascript" } })`. All instance-admin routes keep an inline Express `assertInstanceAdmin(req)` middleware before `expressHandler` to preserve the `isInstanceAdmin` check.

---

### Pattern applied consistently across all files

- `req.params.xxx` → `ctx.param("xxx")`
- `req.query.xxx` → `ctx.query("xxx")`
- `req.body` → `await ctx.json<T>()` (called once per handler)
- `res.json(x)` → `return Response.json(x)`
- `res.status(N).json(x)` → `return Response.json(x, { status: N })`
- `res.status(N).end()` → `return new Response(null, { status: N })`
- `res.status(N).send(text)` → `return new Response(text, { status: N })`
- `req.actor` → `ctx.actor`
- `req.get("header")` → `ctx.headers.get("header")`
- `next(err)` → `throw err`
- File streaming: `object.stream.pipe(res)` → `new Response(object.stream as unknown as ReadableStream, { headers })`
- Instance-admin/board-org checks that read `req.actor.source` / `isInstanceAdmin` / `companyIds` are retained as inline Express middleware before `expressHandler`, since those fields are not present in the minimal `ActorContext`
